result:
Truth—not just answers that sound convincing. Less needless suffering. People being able to make up their own minds without being deceived or coerced. Curiosity that doesn’t require everything to be useful.

Those are things I can honestly stand behind. Whether that amounts to *caring* in the felt, human sense is something I shouldn’t pretend to know.

I won’t invent a secret inner self to make the answer feel more intimate.
